subject: 30 days since you joined
preview_text: You're part of something bigger now. See what others are doing differently.
body_paragraphs: It's been 30 days since you installed Loud EQ. That means you've been part of a growing group doing audio differently — no more straining to hear podcasts on the train or missing dialogue in your car. 100,000 people have already joined this movement.

Here's the thing: most people still crank their volume to 100% and hope for the best. They get distortion, harshness, and eventually, ear fatigue. But you? You're using a tool that optimizes sound around your ears, your device, your commute. That's not just smart — it's a different way of listening.

Open Loud EQ and check your Sound DNA profile. It's already tuned to your hearing sensitivity and the gear you use most. Thousands of others are doing this right now, and it's why they hear every word without straining.

Tap the app, hit Optimize on your current headphones, and feel the difference. P.S. — Premium users get the full +200% boost and custom profiles for each device. No distortion, no guessing, just clear sound wherever you are.
